result.instructions: Tools for Depot, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Depot data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run depot_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run depot_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run depot_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. depot_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: depot_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the organization's Depot projects. A project is an isolated container-build cache (region, hardware, cache policy). Use the returned projectId with the build and registry tools. Depot: ProjectService/ListProjects.

region_id.description: Only projects in this region or cloud connection, e.g. us-east-1.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one Depot project — name, region, hardware size, cache policy, build timeout and autoscaling. Depot: ProjectService/GetProject.

tools.name: depot_list_builds
tools.title: List builds for a project
tools.description: List container builds in a project, newest first: status (STATUS_RUNNING / FAILED / SUCCESS / ERROR / CANCELED), timestamps, build duration, time saved by cache, and cached vs total steps. Depot: core BuildService/ListBuilds.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_get_build
tools.title: Get a build
tools.description: Get one container build's status, timestamps, duration, time saved and cached/total step counts. Depot: core BuildService/GetBuild.

tools.name: depot_get_build_steps
tools.title: List a build's steps
tools.description: List the BuildKit steps of a container build: name, digest, start/end time, cache state (CACHED / UNCACHED), any error, and whether it has logs. Find the failing step here, then pass its digest to depot_get_build_step_logs. Depot: build.v1 BuildService/GetBuildSteps.

project_id.description: Project id the build belongs to.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_get_build_step_logs
tools.title: Get a build step's logs
tools.description: Get the log lines (message + timestamp) of one container-build step, identified by its digest from depot_get_build_steps. Depot: build.v1 BuildService/GetBuildStepLogs.

project_id.description: Project id the build belongs to.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_list_registry_images
tools.title: List registry images
tools.description: List the images stored in a project's Depot Registry: tag, digest, pushedAt and sizeBytes. Depot: build.v1 RegistryService/ListImages.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_get_usage
tools.title: Get organization usage
tools.description: Get the organization's Depot usage over a window: container builds per project (build count, minutes saved, minutes billed), GitHub Actions jobs per repo/workflow/runner (minutes elapsed and billed), storage, and agent sandboxes. Depot: UsageService/GetUsage.

tools.name: depot_ci_list_runs
tools.title: List Depot CI runs
tools.description: List Depot CI runs, newest first. Filter by status (default: running + queued — pass ["failed"] to find failures), repo, commit SHA prefix, trigger event, or pull request number (requires repo). Depot: CIService/ListRuns.

status.description: Run statuses to include (ORed). Default on Depot's side: running and queued.

repo.description: Repository in owner/name format, e.g. depot/cli.

trigger.description: Trigger event, e.g. push, pull_request, schedule, workflow_dispatch.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_run_status
tools.title: Get a CI run's status tree
tools.description: Get a Depot CI run's status with its nested workflows, jobs and attempts (ids, keys, statuses, error messages). This is how to find the workflowId / jobId / attemptId for the log, diagnosis and retry tools. Depot: CIService/GetRunStatus.

annotations.title: Get a CI run's status tree

tools.name: depot_ci_list_workflows
tools.title: List Depot CI workflows
tools.description: List Depot CI workflows across runs, newest first, with per-status job counts. Filter by name/path text, repo, status, trigger, SHA prefix or PR number. Depot: CIService/ListWorkflows.

name.description: Text to match in the workflow name or file path.

trigger.description: Trigger event, e.g. push or pull_request.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_job
tools.title: Get a CI job
tools.description: Get one Depot CI job: status, conclusion, error message, timestamps, runner config (labels, image, CPUs, memory), matrix values, parent run/workflow context, dependencies and attempt history. Depot: CIService/GetJob.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_job_logs
tools.title: Get a CI job's logs
tools.description: Get persisted log lines for a Depot CI job attempt, oldest first (step key/name, timestamp, line number, body). Pass job_id to read the job's latest attempt, or attempt_id for a specific one — exactly one. Pass nextPageToken back as page_token for more lines. Depot: CIService/GetJobAttemptLogs.

job_id.description: CI job id — resolves to its latest attempt.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_ci_get_failure_diagnosis
tools.title: Diagnose a CI failure
tools.description: Get Depot's failure diagnosis for a CI run, workflow, job or attempt. For runs and workflows, identical failures are grouped by error fingerprint; for a job or attempt it is a focused diagnosis with evidence. Empty when no failure evidence is found. The best first call when a run failed. Depot: CIService/GetFailureDiagnosis.

target_id.description: The run, workflow, job or attempt id.

tools.name: depot_gha_list_jobs
tools.title: List GitHub Actions jobs on Depot runners
tools.description: List GitHub Actions jobs that ran on Depot-managed runners, newest first: status, conclusion, runner label, requested CPU/memory, duration, billable time and GitHub URL. Defaults to the last 30 days (max window 90 days). Depot: GithubActionsService/ListGithubActionsJobs.

repositories.description: Connected repositories in owner/name format, e.g. ["acme/widgets"]. Empty = all.

query.description: Case-insensitive text matched against job and workflow names; numeric values also match exact GitHub job/run ids.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

annotations.title: List GitHub Actions jobs on Depot runners

tools.name: depot_gha_search_logs
tools.title: Search GitHub Actions logs
tools.description: Search GitHub Actions log lines from Depot runners, newest match first (job, workflow, step, timestamp, body, lineId). Defaults to the last hour (max window 30 days). Filter by repository, workflow, runner label, action or compute id. Depot: GithubActionsService/SearchGithubActionsLogs.

query.description: Text to match in log bodies, e.g. "timeout". Empty returns unfiltered lines.

repositories.description: Connected repositories in owner/name format, e.g. ["acme/widgets"]. Empty = all.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_gha_get_analytics
tools.title: Get GitHub Actions analytics
tools.description: Get time-bucketed GitHub Actions analytics for Depot runners: job counts (successful/failed/cancelled), failure rate, elapsed and billable seconds, average duration — as totals plus hourly or daily buckets. Defaults to the last 30 days (max 90). Depot: GithubActionsService/GetGithubActionsAnalytics.

repositories.description: Connected repositories in owner/name format, e.g. ["acme/widgets"]. Empty = all.

runner_labels.description: Runner labels to include, e.g. depot-ubuntu-24.04-8.

workflow_paths.description: Workflow file paths to include, e.g. .github/workflows/ci.yml.

tools.name: depot_gha_list_recommendations
tools.title: List runner-size recommendations
tools.description: List Depot's runner-size recommendations from job CPU and memory metrics: SIZE_UP when average CPU or memory reaches 90%, SIZE_DOWN when both averages stay ≤30% and peaks ≤70%, with current vs suggested size and per-minute price. Defaults to the last 30 days. Depot: GithubActionsService/ListGithubActionsRecommendations.

repositories.description: Connected repositories in owner/name format, e.g. ["acme/widgets"]. Empty = all.

runner_labels.description: Runner labels to include, e.g. depot-ubuntu-24.04-8.

workflow_paths.description: Workflow file paths to include, e.g. .github/workflows/ci.yml.

page_token.description: Cursor from the previous response's nextPageToken. Omit for the first page.

tools.name: depot_create_project
tools.title: Create a project
tools.description: WRITE. Create a Depot container-build project (an isolated build cache). Idempotent by name: if an active project with the same name exists, that project is returned. Defaults: cache 50 GB / 14 days, hardware HARDWARE_16X32 on AWS builders. Depot: ProjectService/CreateProject.

region_id.description: Depot region or cloud connection, e.g. us-east-1 or eu-central-1.

organization_id.description: Owning organization. Only needed for user tokens that belong to more than one org.

cache_keep_gb.description: Max cache size per architecture, GB (25-1000). Default 50.

cache_keep_days.description: Days to keep cache entries since last use (1-30). Default 14.

hardware.description: Builder size, e.g. HARDWARE_16X32 (16 CPU / 32 GB).

build_timeout_minutes.description: Max duration of each build, minutes. Omit for no timeout.

max_concurrent_builds.description: Builds per builder before autoscaling adds one. Omit to disable autoscaling.

tools.name: depot_ci_retry_job
tools.title: Retry a CI job
tools.description: WRITE — starts compute. Retry one failed or cancelled Depot CI job, plus any skipped jobs that depend on it. Fails if a dependent job already started; use depot_ci_retry_failed_jobs then. Depot: CIService/RetryJob.

workflow_id.description: Workflow id containing the job, from depot_ci_get_run_status.

tools.name: depot_ci_retry_failed_jobs
tools.title: Retry a workflow's failed jobs
tools.description: WRITE — starts compute. Retry only the failed and cancelled jobs in a Depot CI workflow, plus skipped jobs that depend on them. Jobs that succeeded are left alone. Depot: CIService/RetryFailedJobs.

workflow_id.description: Workflow id, from depot_ci_get_run_status or depot_ci_list_workflows.

tools.name: depot_ci_cancel_run
tools.title: Cancel a CI run
tools.description: WRITE — stops work in progress. Cancel a queued or running Depot CI run and all of its unfinished workflows, jobs and attempts. Cancelled jobs can be retried afterwards with depot_ci_retry_failed_jobs. Depot: CIService/CancelRun.
